meta.task_name: Multimodal synthetic assets generation via OpenAI APIs (when assets are needed)

notes.note: SyntheticDemoInputs currently supports seed_dataset/default_first_run_inputs/expected_outputs, but has no required_assets inventory for text/image/audio assets.
ToolingPlanIfNeeded exists, but seeded assets are not explicitly modeled as in-repo synthetic assets with constraints.
CodeSpecArtifact includes synthetic_data_implementation and tooling_plan, but no asset_generation_plan that mandates OpenAI-generated synthetic assets saved in-repo.
TestingStrategy exists but does not explicitly require “assets exist + sanity checks + startup does not depend on live asset generation.”
Phase rules enforce synthetic seed data and deterministic reruns, but do not hard-require asset inventories (phase 2) or generation plans + validation (phase 3).

objective.summary: Modify spec-generation (schemas + prompts) so that when a demo needs example text/images/audio for synthetic inputs or seeded scenarios: (1) DemoSpec explicitly lists required synthetic assets (type, purpose, where used, format/size constraints, labels), (2) CodeSpec mandates generating those assets via OpenAI APIs (appropriate modality), committing them into the repo under a standard path, (3) CodeSpec includes deterministic-ish generation commands/scripts and app loading/referencing details, (4) Tests validate assets exist, pass basic sanity checks, and demo startup never depends on live asset generation.

field.name: asset_id
field.description: Stable identifier for the asset used for cross-phase references and test mapping.

field.name: asset_type
field.description: Asset modality/type.

field.name: purpose
field.description: Why the asset is needed (seeded scenario, example upload, UI preview, etc.).

field.name: where_used_in_headline_flows
field.description: Which headline demo item(s)/step(s) use this asset (use stable refs/IDs already in the spec, or explicit text references).

field.name: expected_format
field.description: Expected file/text format and constraints (e.g., "png 1024x1024", "wav 16kHz mono", "plain text <= 1KB").

field.name: size_constraints
field.description: Max size guidance suitable for a repo asset and fast demo load (e.g., "< 1MB").

field.name: must_be_labeled_synthetic
field.description: Must be true: asset is explicitly labeled synthetic.

field.name: synthetic_label_text
field.description: Exact label text to associate with this asset (e.g., "Synthetic demo image").

add_required_field.name: required_assets
add_required_field.description: Required inventory of synthetic assets needed to run the demo deterministically (text/images/audio). If no additional assets are needed beyond embedded seed_dataset/expected_outputs, include an empty list.

notes.note: Prefer an empty list rather than omitting the field (keep schema deterministic).
Assets must be explicitly labeled as synthetic via must_be_labeled_synthetic=true and synthetic_label_text.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: SyntheticDemoInputs has required_assets and each asset includes type, purpose, usage mapping, format/size constraints, and explicit synthetic labeling.

field.name: no_real_person_likeness
field.description: Must be true: forbid generating real-person likenesses.

field.name: no_copyrighted_brand_assets
field.description: Must be true: forbid copyrighted brand logos/characters/identifiable IP.

field.name: no_pii
field.description: Must be true: forbid PII in generated text/audio/images.

field.name: content_safety_notes
field.description: Any additional content safety notes or prompts constraints (or "none").

field.name: asset_type
field.description: Which modality this plan item applies to.

field.name: openai_api_surface
field.description: API surface used for generation. (Examples: Responses for text; Realtime only if audio generation/streaming is required; Agents only if multi-step orchestration is required.)

field.name: model
field.description: Model identifier used for this asset generation.

field.name: why_this_choice
field.description: Short justification tied to determinism/cost/quality and demo needs.

field.name: when_assets_are_required
field.description: Explicit rule for interpreting DemoSpec.synthetic_demo_inputs.required_assets: "If empty, no generation needed; if non-empty, generation steps below must be followed and assets must be committed."

field.name: api_and_model_by_asset_type
field.description: Per-modality OpenAI API/model selection plan for asset generation.

field.name: generation_commands_or_scripts
field.description: Concrete scripts or one-off commands to generate assets (prefer deterministic params where possible). Must include how to run locally.

field.name: repo_storage_location
field.description: Where assets are stored in-repo (e.g., "assets/synthetic/").

field.name: naming_convention
field.description: Stable naming convention that includes asset_id and indicates synthetic status.

field.name: how_app_loads_and_references_assets
field.description: How the demo loads these assets at runtime (static import/served files) and how UI references them in seeded flows.

field.name: explicit_synthetic_labeling_in_app
field.description: How the UI labels these assets as synthetic (where labels appear, e.g., captions, tooltips, upload previews).

field.name: guardrails
field.description: Mandatory content guardrails for asset generation.

field.name: no_live_generation_on_startup
field.description: Must be true: demo startup must not depend on live asset generation calls.

add_required_field.name: asset_generation_plan
add_required_field.description: Required plan for generating any needed synthetic assets via OpenAI APIs and committing them into the repo. Must be compatible with the DemoSpec.required_assets inventory.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: CodeSpecArtifact includes required asset_generation_plan with per-modality API/model choices, generation scripts/commands, repo storage + naming, load/reference plan, explicit synthetic labeling, and guardrails.

step.title: Schema: require testing validation for assets + startup independence

add_required_field.name: synthetic_assets_validation
add_required_field.description: Required test/verification requirements for synthetic assets: - assets exist at expected repo paths - basic sanity checks (file type/extension, non-zero size, size limits) - demo startup does not depend on live asset generation (no network calls required to render seeded flows) Provide concrete test target locations and how to run.

notes.note: This complements existing verification_steps; ensure those steps include an assets validation command or test.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: TestingStrategy includes synthetic_assets_validation with explicit checks: existence, type/size sanity, and startup independence from live generation.

step.title: Prompts: enforce asset inventory (phase 2) and generation plan + tests (phase 3)

update_global_hard_rules.add_rule: If the demo needs example text/images/audio assets, they must be synthetic and generated via OpenAI APIs (appropriate modality), saved in-repo, and explicitly labeled synthetic in the UI. Do not source ad-hoc internet content.
Demo startup must not depend on live asset generation; assets must already exist in the repo and be validated by tests.

update_phase_rules.add_rule: SyntheticDemoInputs must include required_assets listing any text/image/audio assets needed for seeded scenarios or example uploads, including purpose, where used in headline flows, format/size constraints, and explicit synthetic labeling. If none are needed, required_assets must be an empty list.

update_phase_priority_checklist.add_item: Populate synthetic_demo_inputs.required_assets (or empty list) with asset_type, purpose, where-used mapping, format/size constraints, and explicit synthetic labeling.

update_phase_rules.add_rule: CodeSpec must include asset_generation_plan that maps each required asset modality to OpenAI API/model choices, provides generation scripts/commands, specifies repo storage (e.g., assets/synthetic/), naming conventions, and how the app loads/labels them as synthetic.
TestingStrategy must include synthetic_assets_validation verifying assets exist, pass basic sanity checks, and that demo startup does not require live asset generation.

update_phase_priority_checklist.add_item: Include asset_generation_plan (API/model per modality, generation scripts/commands, repo storage + naming, app load/reference, UI synthetic labels, guardrails, no_live_generation_on_startup=true).

notes.note: Preserve JSON-only output and strict schema adherence.
Do not introduce new tools unless required; this task is about generating and committing assets, not runtime tool loops.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Phase-2 output reliably includes required_assets inventory (or empty list), preventing missing asset requirements later.
Phase-3 output reliably includes asset_generation_plan + synthetic_assets_validation with concrete commands and checks.

verify.item: After adding nested objects to demo_spec and code_spec schemas, confirm openai_compatible_schema() still produces strict-compatible schemas (additionalProperties:false, required includes all properties, $ref-only nodes).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No regressions in strict structured output compatibility.

checks.check: Every generated DemoSpec includes synthetic_demo_inputs.required_assets (or empty list) with modality, usage mapping, format/size constraints, and explicit synthetic labeling.
Every generated CodeSpec includes asset_generation_plan that mandates OpenAI-generated synthetic assets committed in-repo, with generation commands/scripts and app load/reference plan.
Every generated CodeSpec includes testing_strategy.synthetic_assets_validation ensuring assets exist, are sane, and demo startup does not depend on live asset generation.
Prompt rules/checklists enforce the above so downstream coding agents implement assets deterministically and safely.
